BSc/MSc in Computer Science or a related field
6+ years of relevant professional experience
Strong experience with Power BI and DAX
Knowledge of report design, KPI visualization, visual hierarchy, and data storytelling
Experience working with semantic models and Microsoft Fabric connectivity
Understanding of Power BI performance optimization and reporting best practices
Strong attention to usability, consistency, and visual standards
